scope: Local exploratory baseline and feature-sensitivity comparisons after inspecting the first primary SVM evaluation
not_a_preregistration: Recorded and hashed locally before these comparison fits; the primary results were already known. No external registration or Git commit is claimed.
reference: checkpoints/2026-10-13-svm-training; reuse its verified held-out primary predictions and per-outer-fold parameters
population: Frozen original 2968-record benchmark; layer II uses its 1484 known enhancers only
folds: Reuse the frozen five outer and three inner grouped folds exactly, joining by record_id
svm_protocol: training_protocol.json; same C/gamma grid, solver, balanced-accuracy selection, exact tie rule and unscaled features

baselines.majority: Predict the most frequent training label in each outer fold; ties choose 0. Use the training positive fraction as a constant ranking score. No sequence features or tuning.
baselines.gc_only: One feature: (count(G)+count(C))/sequence length. RBF SVM with inner-fold C/gamma tuning.
baselines.sixmer_only: 4096 ordinary overlapping 6-mer frequencies, divided by 195 windows in each 200-base sequence, lexical A,C,G,T order. No theta terms, PseKNC denominator, fitted scaling, reverse-complement pooling or k selection. RBF SVM with inner-fold C/gamma tuning.

sensitivity_modes.retuned: Refit each variant with C/gamma selected using only its three inner folds, on the unchanged grid. Tests the whole variant-plus-tuning procedure.
sensitivity_modes.fixed_primary_parameters: Refit each variant using the primary model's saved C/gamma for that same outer fold, without retuning. Tests replacement of the feature representation at fixed parameters. These parameters were selected for primary features, so this is a sensitivity check, not a fair optimized-baseline contest.

feature_inputs: Verify every alternate matrix against the existing feature checkpoint's shape, array hash, feature order, IDs and labels; compute baseline features from the audited sequences
model_export: Save all comparison outer-fold SVMs as numeric NPZ with explicit feature identity. Require exact held-out class agreement and absolute decision-score replay error <=1e-6, fixed before these fits.
summary: Per-fold and equal-weight macro accuracy, balanced accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, MCC, ROC AUC and average precision. Rank scores only within folds. Report pooled confusion counts and prediction disagreements with primary. No pooled AUC/AP.

paired_bootstrap.unit: Whole groups sampled with replacement within each outer fold; identical resampled rows for every method in that layer
paired_bootstrap.interval: Pointwise 2.5th/97.5th percentiles for macro metrics and comparator-minus-primary paired differences
paired_bootstrap.limitation: Conditional on saved fits and folds, without refitting. Exploratory and not multiplicity-adjusted; no confirmatory significance, population equivalence or best-model selection claim.

grid_boundaries: Report selected C/gamma endpoints. Do not expand the grid after inspecting comparisons. The same numeric grid does not imply identical effective regularization across feature scales.
exclusions: selecting a winning feature variant from outer scores
publishing or pushing without user agreement
